correctness.rationale: Vertices sharing a neighbor in the cycle prism differ by ±(1,1) or ±(2,0). The generator (1,1) has order 2n for odd n and n for even n, proving the single/double square-cycle decomposition. Cyclic gaps at least 3 give the exact independent-set polynomial N/(N-2k) binomial(N-2k,k), while maximum-subset partitions reduce to residue-class exact covers and seven explicitly classified perfect matchings of the eight-vertex Möbius ladder. The alternate sixteen-state transfer matrix has its characteristic determinant checked exactly by all Newton identities, yielding the rational series. Exhaustive distinct direct graph checks cover all 87,360 subsets for n=3,...,8, and the cycle-gap and transfer polynomials agree for n=3,...,60. Small cases and finite experiments are corroboration, not proofs of universality.

originality.rationale: The 2018 Cartesian-product exact-distance theorem gives general adjacency decomposition, not the identified single/double cycle-square independent-set polynomial, six-class maximizer counts, or perfect-partition classification. The 2023 bipartite-prism theorem determines a scalar maximum for even n, not the complete enumerator and partition counts, and does not apply to odd n. The 2021/2023 injective-coloring references describe two-step graphs and color thresholds, not the asserted prism distribution in inspected sections. Relevant published-result and literature searches uncovered no identical or stronger claim. The classical ingredients make an implicit previous derivation a genuine risk, but the inspected primary theorem statements do not by themselves assert this specialization.
residual_risks: General exact-distance product decompositions and the established cyclic-gap independent-set formula together make implicit prior derivation plausible; absence from searches does not establish priority.

value.rationale: The object is a canonical cubic family and open packings are natural injective color classes. The result gives the entire coefficient profile and a non-obvious parity-dependent decomposition into one or two cycle-square factors, not just a minimum. The six-case maximum multiplicities and complete perfect maximum-packing partition classification, including exceptional orders 4 and 8 and the 1176 extremal partitions at the latter order, answer a motivated exact-cover question suggested by earlier work on perfect injective colorability. It is a natural infinite classification with exact self-contained proof, not a computation of isolated numerical cells.
